asked.item: Can six slide images and one video go in a single LinkedIn carousel?
Six images as a carousel for the company page (within the 2-10 image range)

verdict.reason: The help pages directly state that videos cannot be mixed into a LinkedIn carousel and that carousels take 2-10 image URLs, which answers the customer's question.

steps.text: No, videos cannot be mixed into a LinkedIn carousel.
A LinkedIn carousel takes 2 to 10 image URLs in content.mediaUrls, so six images can form a carousel.
A video can be published as its own LinkedIn post, separate from the carousel.
